title: Trump ‘not concerned’ about WPS tensions: It ‘would be taken care of’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he is “not concerned” about tensions in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) as it “would be taken care of.”
Trump made the remark when asked how concerned he was about tensions in the WPS and whether he was ready in case the Mutual Defense Treaty (MDT) was invoked.
The MDT between Manila and Washington calls for each country to defend the other in case of an armed attack.

“I am not concerned at all, I am not concerned about that at all, that would be taken care of,” Trump said in response to reporters during a bilateral meeting with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Malacañang.
